svg.title: Arquitetura do FinanceFlow
svg.desc: Diagrama de arquitetura mostrando as camadas do FinanceFlow: Frontend React, Backend .NET 9 Clean Architecture, e Infraestrutura com SQL Server, Redis e Kafka

g.text: ASP.NET Core 9 — Controllers, JWT Auth, Swagger, SignalR Hub
CQRS com MediatR — Commands, Queries, Handlers, Validators
EF Core, Repositórios, Kafka Producer, Redis Cache, SendGrid, Anthropic
Entidades, Value Objects, Interfaces, Domain Events — sem dependências externas
